variants.user_notes: Its USB filter matches any device with an FTDI FT232H chip.
variants.maintainer_notes: Programmed with iceprog through its FTDI FT232H chip, as the board maker's examples do (github.com/skerr92/ice5lp4k_examples). It was defined with icesprog, which can only reach MuseLab's iCELink, not an FTDI chip. Not tried on hardware.
